verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents broad programmatic coverage. You can create connected accounts via API, the official CLI exposes a 'broad slice' of the API for reading and writing resources, and AgentOS MCP lets agents read and write production resources. No source claims full UI-to-API parity, and some web-app functions (e.g. webhook delivery inspection and re-delivery) are documented only in the web app. missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity statement, evidence that web-app-only functions like webhook re-delivery and inspection are exposed via API, independent corroboration of coverage breadth.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Programmatically create connected accounts for businesses and individuals, and enable them with rich financial capabilities.
exposes a broad slice of the Airwallex API as terminal commands, so you can read and write your Airwallex resources in sandbox or production
Airwallex AgentOS MCP lets agents read and write production Airwallex resources from non-terminal environments
It gives you access to all products in the Airwallex web app and API (except Connected Account APIs)
